introHtml: Bulwark is a trusted brand in flame-resistant workwear, and their pants and shorts are built to withstand the toughest industrial environments. When you order custom Bulwark pants shorts for your crew, you get durable fabrics like 100% cotton or cotton/nylon blends with arc ratings up to 8.6 cal/cm². Add your company logo via screen printing or heat transfer for a professional look that meets safety compliance.
